note: SAMPLE scholarships for the prototype. Names, amounts and dates are illustrative, not real schemes.

items.title: State Merit Scholarship for Engineering
items.description: For engineering students with strong academic results and limited family income.

items.title: Cyber Security Skills Fellowship
items.description: Supports students specialising in cyber security and information technology.

items.title: First-Generation Learner Grant
items.description: For students who are the first in their family to attend college.

items.title: Women in Technology Scholarship
items.description: Encourages women studying engineering and technology.

items.title: Post-Matric Scholarship (SC/ST/OBC)
items.description: Tuition support for students from reserved categories.

items.title: Rural Talent Scholarship
items.description: For students from rural districts studying professional courses.

items.title: Maharashtra Technical Education Award
items.description: For students whose home state is Maharashtra.

items.title: Tamil Nadu Engineering Excellence Scholarship
items.description: For students whose home state is Tamil Nadu.
